freshness_limit_reason: agent_thread_limit; reviewer thread previously performed result-to-claim and mechanical merge but generated no pivot candidate

penalties.complexity: 0-6 points; penalizes module count, researcher degrees of freedom, runtime, and 4+1-page story burden
penalties.synthetic_only_gate: 0-4 points; penalizes gates that can pass on constructed signals without establishing transfer to real supplied tracks

rubric.final_score_formula: sum(seven criteria) - complexity penalty - synthetic-only gate penalty
rubric.tie_break: higher direct_residual_delta, then higher scientific_novelty, then stable union order
rubric.budget_rule: A range/string or estimate above 8 GPU-hours is not an elimination criterion; any reconsideration requires a preregistered reduced pilot at or below 8 GPU-hours.

verdict.rationale: Most candidates are generic masked, predictive, consistency, memory, or phase variants already crowded by the checked priors. Two task-specific residual questions remain worth primary-source adjudication, but neither has a real efficacy result or protocol clearance.

ranking.title: Set-Valued Counting Under Pose Missingness
ranking.strongest_objection: The proposed interval can be vacuously wide, and containment of the method's own full-observation estimate is not coverage of true count; pose-repair, conformal, and uncertainty-set literature may also absorb the apparent novelty.
ranking.cheap_decisive_gate: Freeze one analytic bank, one train-only uncertainty-set constructor, nested real-track masks, and a trivial interval baseline. Kill if nesting fails once, full-observation frozen-response containment is below 95%, width is non-monotone, median width exceeds 1.5 cycles at 30% missing joints, or the method is not tighter than the trivial baseline at matched containment.
ranking.direct_residual_delta: The plausible residual is count-interval propagation and non-vacuity under missing pose, not pose repair, robustness, masking, or point counting.
ranking.budget_handling: Numeric estimate is 3 GPU-hours and within the idea-creator pilot ceiling; no implementation authority follows.

ranking.title: Fragment-Boundary Transport for Count-Mass Conservation
ranking.strongest_objection: Conserving a frozen base response can preserve a biased counter, while endpoint correction across long gaps may be unidentifiable and may reduce to generic tracklet/gap completion.
ranking.cheap_decisive_gate: Freeze the base response before cuts and compare no correction, linear endpoint correction, and transport on held-out cut/gap families. Kill unless transport halves intact-versus-fragment mass error, keeps wrong-identity boundary weight at or below 10%, and leaves byte-identical untouched identities unchanged.
ranking.direct_residual_delta: The plausible residual is an explicit compositional law for count mass across supplied-track fragmentation and re-entry, not tracking, temporal consistency, overlap-add, or a new base counter.
ranking.budget_handling: Numeric estimate is 6 GPU-hours and within the idea-creator pilot ceiling; no implementation authority follows.

ranking.title: Leave-One-Person-Out Common-Mode Cancellation
ranking.strongest_objection: Hip centering may already remove most camera motion; genuine synchronized actions can occupy the common subspace, and one-person or weak-overlap scenes make the mechanism inapplicable.
ranking.cheap_decisive_gate: Before learning, audit eligible multi-person overlap and run frozen shared-camera injections. Kill if fewer than 30% of eligible tracks have sufficient overlap, nuisance attenuation is below 15 dB, or target oscillatory-energy preservation is below 90%.
ranking.direct_residual_delta: A task-specific nuisance front end is plausible, but robust common-mode subtraction is classical and MultiCounter+ already owns multi-person consistency.
ranking.budget_handling: Numeric estimate is 1 GPU-hour; low cost does not cure the weak novelty residual.

ranking.title: Conditioned Hankel Pole-Path Posterior
ranking.strongest_objection: Matrix pencils, pole tracking, harmonic families, and conditioning diagnostics are classical; a synthetic oscillator suite does not show that estimated poles correspond to semantic repetitions in human motion.
ranking.cheap_decisive_gate: Freeze ranks, windows, linking costs, and abstention thresholds before a CPU pose-shaped suite. Kill if count error exceeds 10% on well-conditioned cases, fewer than 85% of ill-conditioned cases abstain, or small valid-coordinate perturbations change count by more than 10%.
ranking.direct_residual_delta: Useful as a transparent failure-aware baseline, but posterior packaging and abstention do not create a strong new RAC mechanism.
ranking.budget_handling: Numeric estimate is 0 GPU-hours; feasibility is excellent but is not novelty.

ranking.title: Persistent-Cohomology Crossing Ensemble
ranking.strongest_objection: Embedding dimension, lag, joint subsets, persistence threshold, circular coordinates, and section ensemble create many researcher degrees of freedom; synthetic loop success may not transfer to open, drifting, or self-intersecting actions.
ranking.cheap_decisive_gate: Freeze every topology and section parameter before running known loops plus unlabelled real-track resampling and shuffled-time controls. Kill if median known-loop error exceeds 0.25 cycles, monotone resampling changes winding by more than 2%, shuffled-time false loops exceed 5%, or non-loop abstention is below 80%.
ranking.direct_residual_delta: Topological crossing with an explicit identifiability certificate is distinct from PAMS/DeepPhase in form, but the candidate lacks a defensible low-degree-of-freedom real-track bridge.
ranking.budget_handling: Numeric estimate is 2 GPU-hours; the blocker is scientific complexity and proxy transfer, not compute.

ranking.title: Band-Marginalized Limb-Phase Synchronization
ranking.strongest_objection: Wavelet phase, cross-channel synchronization, and uncertainty are crowded signal-processing components; the mechanism can look like harmonic correction around the terminally failed phase route and collides with PAMS, DeepPhase, Runia, and accessible TWCRAC evidence.
ranking.cheap_decisive_gate: Use a new immutable pack with no WARP fixture reuse and freeze bands, graph edges, and abstention rules. Kill if winding error exceeds 10%, half/double locking exceeds 5%, or ambiguous-case detection is below 80% at 10% false alarms.
ranking.direct_residual_delta: Marginal SO(2) synchronization rather than hard period selection is a possible distinction, but it is too close to the killed phase/harmonic problem and has no real-track gate.
ranking.budget_handling: Numeric estimate is 4 GPU-hours; rejection is not budget-based.

ranking.title: Cross-Person Nuisance-Rejected Track Encoding
ranking.strongest_objection: Counterfactual invariance and adversarial nuisance suppression are generic; identity isolation is already a diagnostic rather than a method contribution, and aggressive suppression may remove real interaction cues.
ranking.cheap_decisive_gate: First reduce to at most 8 GPU-hours. With target bytes fixed, kill if non-target interventions change target embeddings beyond tolerance, target masked-delta utility does not beat static/velocity baselines, or co-actor/person-count probes exceed the frozen chance margin.
ranking.direct_residual_delta: The exact co-actor counterfactual audit is useful, but the learned representation adds little beyond the already-required identity-interference diagnostic.
ranking.budget_handling: The 12-22 hour string/range did not cause rejection; any reconsideration requires a preregistered reduced pilot at or below 8 GPU-hours.

ranking.title: Motion-Arrow Factorized Representation
ranking.strongest_objection: Time reversal can be physically implausible, reversal/content disentanglement is generic, and no mechanism directly connects the factorization to repetition counts beyond a downstream hope.
ranking.cheap_decisive_gate: Reduce to at most 8 GPU-hours and remove all reversal-token and padding shortcuts. Kill if content/arrow objectives do not beat pooled-pose and local-velocity baselines, either subspace collapses, or independence fails under a frozen criterion.
ranking.direct_residual_delta: Direction/content factorization is not covered verbatim by the listed RAC priors, but its repetition-specific delta is weak and temporal equivariance is established.
ranking.budget_handling: The 8-14 hour string/range did not cause rejection; any reconsideration requires a preregistered reduced pilot at or below 8 GPU-hours.

ranking.title: Masked Multi-Horizon Pose-Delta Prediction
ranking.strongest_objection: MAMP, MotionBERT, and SkeletonMAE already occupy masked motion and multi-horizon pose representation territory; fixed horizons are not repetition-specific.
ranking.cheap_decisive_gate: Reduce to at most 8 GPU-hours and compare directly with a matched MAMP-style masked-velocity predictor, constant velocity, interpolation, and temporal shuffle. Kill if the candidate does not win the objective and frozen linear-readout tests under matched capacity.
ranking.direct_residual_delta: The only residual is applying an established pretext to supplied-track MRAC, which is not enough for a primary contribution.
ranking.budget_handling: The 8-14 hour string/range did not cause rejection; any reconsideration requires a preregistered reduced pilot at or below 8 GPU-hours.

ranking.title: Closed-Loop Multiplicity Calibration for Additive Count Mass
ranking.strongest_objection: RepNet already uses synthetic repetitions; a learner can detect return-path or stitching seams, and an entirely synthetic gate can pass without learning a semantic real-action count measure.
ranking.cheap_decisive_gate: Freeze disjoint atom generators and seam-matched non-loop controls. Kill if held-out-generator multiplicity MAE exceeds 0.15, random-cut additivity error exceeds 5%, time-shuffled controls exceed 0.25 mass, or seam-only probes retain more than 20% of the gain.
ranking.direct_residual_delta: Absolute additive mass calibration is narrower than RepNet's period head, but transfer beyond synthetic construction is unproven and the residual is not yet persuasive.
ranking.budget_handling: Numeric estimate is exactly 8 GPU-hours; rejection is scientific, not budget-based.

ranking.title: Predictive-Surprise Repetition Representation
ranking.strongest_objection: Next-step likelihood is a generic predictive pretext, and surprise is more likely to track occlusion, camera disturbance, or tracker noise than recurrence.
ranking.cheap_decisive_gate: Reduce to at most 8 GPU-hours. Kill unless likelihood and calibration beat last-pose, constant-velocity, and unconditional baselines and monotonic-motion, shuffled-window, confidence-only, and camera-noise controls retain under 20% of the proposed representation gain.
ranking.direct_residual_delta: Calibrated surprise is not present verbatim in the listed RAC methods, but the connection to counting is indirect and weak.
ranking.budget_handling: The 10-18 hour string/range did not cause rejection; any reconsideration requires a preregistered reduced pilot at or below 8 GPU-hours.

ranking.title: Cross-View Kinematic Residual Denoising
ranking.strongest_objection: Coordinate and kinematic views are deterministically coupled, so residual denoising can be solved by local algebra or interpolation; masking and motion reconstruction are already saturated by SkeletonMAE, MAMP, MotionBERT, and TSSM work.
ranking.cheap_decisive_gate: Reduce to at most 8 GPU-hours and compare with direct masked motion, per-joint interpolation, same-view denoising, and MAMP-style prediction. Kill if any simple baseline matches residual error or frozen downstream utility.
ranking.direct_residual_delta: Complementary-view residual targets are a design variation, not a clear new principle beyond established masked skeleton modeling.
ranking.budget_handling: The 10-16 hour string/range did not cause rejection; any reconsideration requires a preregistered reduced pilot at or below 8 GPU-hours.

ranking.title: Track-Exclusive Overlap Bootstrap Consistency
ranking.strongest_objection: Student-teacher overlap agreement is generic bootstrap self-supervision and can encode pose identity or exact-frame copying; TWCRAC and temporal consistency work already crowd the temporal-overlap story.
ranking.cheap_decisive_gate: Reduce to at most 8 GPU-hours and kill unless overlap prediction beats identity-copy, recency, and untrained-teacher baselines while clock, crop offset, track length, and padding probes explain under 20% of gain and effective rank stays above the frozen floor.
ranking.direct_residual_delta: Track-private exact-frame alignment is a protocol detail, not a persuasive direct delta beyond temporal consistency priors.
ranking.budget_handling: The 10-18 hour string/range did not cause rejection; any reconsideration requires a preregistered reduced pilot at or below 8 GPU-hours.

ranking.title: Identity-Private Soft Loop-Closure Memory
ranking.strongest_objection: Dense soft matching is effectively TSSM/attention memory, may collapse to recency or a near-hard selector, is quadratic in track length, and risks disguising a resurrection of the terminal WARP phase-selection route.
ranking.cheap_decisive_gate: Reduce to at most 8 GPU-hours and freeze memory support and entropy. Kill if uniform, fixed-recency, or kernel smoothing matches reconstruction; age/clock probes retain over 20% of gain; occupancy collapses; or the soft distribution concentrates into a hidden hard selector.
ranking.direct_residual_delta: Identity-private storage is established and soft recurrence is adjacent to TSSM, PAMS, DeepPhase, RepNet, and TWCRAC; no clean residual remains.
ranking.budget_handling: The 12-20 hour string/range did not cause rejection; any reconsideration requires a preregistered reduced pilot at or below 8 GPU-hours.

primary_source_novelty_check_queue.exact_question: Has prior primary work already propagated missing-pose uncertainty into calibrated or set-valued repetition-count intervals, rather than repairing pose or predicting a point count?
required_boundaries: SSTRAC and other skeleton repair/occlusion RAC
partial identification under missing time-series observations
primary_source_novelty_check_queue.pass_condition: A narrow residual remains only if primary sources do not already disclose calibrated count intervals under pose missingness and the claim is limited to non-vacuous interval propagation.
primary_source_novelty_check_queue.failure_condition: Any primary source disclosing equivalent count-interval propagation, or inability to state the delta without claiming generic uncertainty sets, kills preferred status.

primary_source_novelty_check_queue.exact_question: Has prior primary RAC or tracking work already learned a compositional boundary correction that conserves count mass across track fragmentation, gaps, and re-entry?
required_boundaries: MultiCounter and MultiCounter+ full fragmentation/re-entry mechanisms
endpoint transport or boundary correction for temporal response composition
primary_source_novelty_check_queue.pass_condition: A residual remains only for an explicit count-mass composition law whose benefit is not generic interpolation, tracking, or self-consistency.
primary_source_novelty_check_queue.failure_condition: Equivalent tracklet/gap composition or inability to separate the idea from preserving a biased base response removes it from consideration.

provisional_preferred.why: It poses the cleanest signal-processing question, is feasible within the pilot ceiling, can produce a meaningful negative result if useful non-vacuous bounds are impossible, and has the clearest residual beyond point prediction and pose repair.
provisional_preferred.why_not_authorized: The current audit has no valid real-data pipeline or result, novelty is unchecked beyond the existing ledger, interval coverage may be vacuous, and same-family non-fresh review is provisional.

warp_phase_terminal_boundary.action: Do not tune, retry, reinterpret, or resurrect WARP-PHASE, its selector, fixture population, harmonic rules, or server route.
warp_phase_terminal_boundary.pivot_separation: No selected candidate is a WARP threshold repair or a continuation of its phase-integral objective.

nonselection_note: All 14 candidates remain in the union. Jury rejection or hold dispositions remove candidates only from the current novelty-check queue; no source candidate was deleted.
